claims.sentence: <jats:title>Summary</jats:title><jats:sec><jats:title>Background</jats:title><jats:p>Few studies have evaluated the effects of rabeprazole on low‐dose aspirin (<jats:styled-content style="fixed-case">LDA</jats:styled-content>)‐induced gastroduodenal injuries.</jats:p></jats:sec><jats:sec><jats:title>Aim</jats:title><jats:p>To conduct a randomised, double‐blind, triple‐dummy, active‐controlled, multicentre trial, named the PLANETARIUM study, to assess the efficacy, dose-response relationship and safety of rabeprazole for peptic ulcer recurrence in Japanese patients on long‐term <jats:styled-content style="fixed-case">LDA</jats:styled-content> therapy.</jats:p></jats:sec><jats:sec><jats:title>Methods</jats:title><jats:p>Eligible patients had a history of endoscopically confirmed peptic ulcers and were receiving long‐term <jats:styled-content style="fixed-case">LDA</jats:styled-content> (81 or 100 mg/day) therapy for cardiovascular or cerebrovascular protection.
